name: Access Request Reviewer
description: Sent to each access reviewer who needs to review an access request.
subject: A new access request for ${requestedForIdentityName} is ready for review
body:
Approval required for an access request

Hello ${user.name},

${requesterName} has requested the #if(${requestedObjectType}=="Role") role #elseif(${requestedObjectType}=="Entitlement") entitlement #else access profile #end ${requestedObjectName}#if($requesterName != $requestedForIdentityName) for ${requestedForIdentityName}#end.

#if($requestContextInformation && $requestContextInformation.size() > 0)

Contextual information provided:

    #foreach($key in $requestContextInformation.keySet())
  • ${key}: ${requestContextInformation.get($key)}
    • #end
#end#if($requesterComments)

${requesterName} has provided the following justification:
"${requesterComments}"

#end#if($startDate)

The start date for ${requestedObjectName} is ${startDate}.

#end#if($removeDate)

The end date for ${requestedObjectName} is ${removeDate}.

#end#if($requestedObjectType=="Role")#if($accessibleItems && $accessibleItems.size() > 0)

If this request is approved, ${requestedForIdentityName} will receive the following access:

    #foreach($item in $accessibleItems)
  • $item
    • #end
#end#elseif($requestedObjectType=="AccessProfile")

If this request is approved, ${requestedForIdentityName} will receive all entitlements contained in the access profile ${accessProfileName}.

#end
Review Request

Best regards,
The ${PRODUCT_NAME} Team
